entries.rule: docs/standards.md §1.1 event tags carry the portal context prefix
entries.reason: Portal event tags predate the context-prefix standard and are persisted in outbox history and consumed by registered handlers; an in-place rename would strand replay or require unsafe simultaneous consumer migration.
entries.compensatingCheck: The standards matrix and exhaustive event-envelope audit keep the exact Portal variance visible while still enforcing the envelope, constructor, union, documentation, and consumer catalogues.
entries.sunsetTrigger: Remove after a versioned Portal event vocabulary has completed dual-read replay compatibility, all durable consumers have migrated, and the retained outbox window contains no old-only tag.

entries.rule: docs/standards.md §2.1 application orchestration throws tagged errors or returns explicit ordinary outcomes instead of propagating Result
entries.reason: These retained Goal commands and queries expose async Result contracts to existing callers; converting them in place would change authorization, validation, and delivery-boundary behavior across the active Goal surface.
entries.compensatingCheck: The exhaustive application-flow checker snapshots every affected file and prevents Result propagation from appearing in another context unnoticed; Goal errors remain typed and callers keep explicit branch handling.
entries.sunsetTrigger: Remove one path at a time after its public callers and server mapper move atomically to enumerable GoalError throws or an explicit ordinary-outcome union with regression coverage.

entries.rule: docs/standards.md §2.1 application orchestration throws tagged errors or returns explicit ordinary outcomes instead of propagating Result
entries.reason: Targeted reply reconciliation retains an async Result contract consumed by its existing job and server orchestration, while Material Review Revision currently throws native Error values for invalid revision construction; isolated edits would change failure, retry, and constructor interpretation across active Review paths.
entries.compensatingCheck: The exhaustive application-flow and domain-error checkers pin both Review variances exactly; reconciliation failures remain ReviewError values and Material Review Revision construction remains covered by invariant tests.
entries.sunsetTrigger: Remove when the reconciliation caller and use case migrate together to tagged ReviewError throws plus explicit non-error publication outcomes, and Material Review Revision construction uses the same enumerable tagged-error authority with retry and invariant regression coverage.

entries.compensatingCheck: The exhaustive native-domain-error checker pins this sole Activity variance exactly, and replay-fact invariant tests continue to exercise malformed evidence.
entries.sunsetTrigger: Remove when replay-fact construction and every recovery caller migrate atomically to an enumerable Activity error tag with corrupt-evidence and retry regression coverage.
